meta_description: A fully-featured, cross-platform and open-source audio engine designed with the needs of games in mind.
hero_lead: Empower your next game or VR project with an immersive audio solution
hero_body: A fully-featured, cross-platform audio engine designed with the needs of games in mind. Spatialize, occlude, reflect and drive every sound from gameplay.
lab_lead: Scroll to step through five of Amplitude's features, or pick one directly. Each scene is a simplified model of what the engine computes for your sources every frame.
lab_aria: {title} simulation on a field of dots: {desc}
mode_attenuation_desc: Fade each source with distance inside a sphere, box, capsule or cone attenuation shape.
mode_occlusion_desc: Blocking geometry dims and muffles what sits behind it.
mode_reflections_desc: Early reflections bounce off the walls and build the room.
mode_hrtf_desc: Each ear hears the source differently, so the listener feels its exact position.
mode_rtpc_desc: Drive engine parameters from gameplay values through RTPC curves.
engine_games_desc: An entity-based architecture and an optimized API let you integrate Amplitude in your game without hassle.
engine_data_desc: Assets are authored as JSON files. Write them, and let Amplitude do the rest of the magic for you.
engine_platforms_desc: Amplitude runs on Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS and Android, with web and console targets on the way.
engine_fast_desc: Entity management and audio processing are fast: Amplitude makes extensive use of SIMD-optimized operations internally.
engine_plugins_desc: Amplitude is extensible. Create custom plugins to add new filters, codecs and more to the engine.
engine_learning_desc: Amplitude follows the concepts of audio programming for games. Even without experience, you get started quickly.
more_ambisonics_desc: Play physically accurate Ambisonics sources from first to third order, spatialized in real time with your HRTF asset.
more_pipeline_desc: Take full control of how the engine renders audio, with one pipeline you shape across all platforms.
more_effects_desc: Apply effects such as echo and gain to whole environments in real time, and build your own through plugins.
more_packages_desc: Build, package and distribute your project as a single bundle file with all your audio files included.
integrations_lead: Start from the C++ SDK in your own engine, or drop in an official integration for O3DE or Flax Engine.
int_cpp_desc: Use the official C++ SDK to integrate Amplitude in your own engine or game. It is the fastest way to get started.
int_o3de_desc: Amplitude integrates seamlessly into your O3DE projects through O3DE's Audio Translation Layer.
int_flax_desc: A Flax Engine plugin built on top of a custom Flax Engine audio system brings Amplitude straight into your editor.
custom_desc: Amplitude can be integrated directly into in-house engines, game projects and custom toolchains. From wiring the audio layer into your runtime to setting up your pipeline and supporting your team, get a tailored integration built around your project's needs.
oss_title: Free. Open Source. Yours to Ship.
oss_desc: Amplitude Audio SDK is licensed under Apache-2.0. Read the code, fork it, ship it in your games, and help shape what comes next.
support_lead: Questions, bugs or ideas: here is where to find us.

support_issues_desc: Report a bug or request a feature.
support_discord_desc: Chat with the team and other developers.
